context.question: What percentage of all seedlings survived across the two zones? Report the percentage on a 0 to 100 scale.
context.ctx_table: Zone North: 160 seedlings planted, 136 survived. Zone South: 240 seedlings planted, 180 survived.
context.ctx_text: Both zones belong to the same reporting period. Combine their counts before calculating the overall percentage.

required_outputs.answer: Overall surviving seedlings divided by overall planted seedlings, multiplied by 100; numeric percent
